Lorcana Noobs here! We piggy dipped our little piggy toes into this TCG, and mama loves TCGs. 🪄 Decided to give this “pack rush” variant a go. Each get two packs, combine and shuffle the 24 cards to make a single deck BUT don’t look at the cards! It’s a surprise! The two non-playable cards act as starting ink to give you a boost and the first to 15 lore wins! And that was me, in case you missed it! -Dani
